note: Japan: a foreign national performing in theatre, entertainment, music, sport or other show business needs the Entertainer status of residence (興行), Immigration Control and Refugee Recognition Act, Appended Table I(2); paid artistic work outside show business is the Artist status (芸術). The Act names no days of such work without the status. Read from e-Gov's law data, since the Immigration Services Agency's and MOFA's pages refuse this client.

sources.said: 興行 演劇、演芸、演奏、スポーツ等の興行に係る活動又はその他の芸能活動（この表の経営・管理の項の下欄に掲げる活動を除く。）
